paragraphs: Rabbi Vallas. Gittin 29a: Rabbi Hillel bar Vallas; Rashi: Vallas. In Sanhedrin 36a, Rashi: son of Rabbi Vallas. Rashi intends the reading Vallas, not Valos, a gentile name in Gittin chapter 1, 11b; see there.
